question: Among the following Para athletes, which athlete is associated with the High Jump event?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mariyappan Thangavelu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu** is an Indian **Para High Jumper** who competes in the **T42 category**, which is for athletes with a single above-knee amputation or comparable disability.
 
• He made history by winning the **gold medal** in the **2016 Rio Paralympics**, becoming the first Indian para-athlete to win gold in the High Jump
